default_timeout_ms.label: Default auto-dismiss timeout (ms)
default_timeout_ms.description: How long the toast stays up when no profile or caller supplies timeout_ms; zero in a profile disables auto-dismiss.

show_icon.label: Show severity icon
show_icon.description: Show a glyph beside the toast text.

icon_text_gap.label: Icon-to-text gap
icon_text_gap.description: Horizontal space between the glyph and text column.

line_gap.label: Text line gap
line_gap.description: Vertical space between summary and body.

content_padding_h.label: Horizontal content padding
content_padding_h.description: Extra padding inside Noctalia's built-in panel padding.

content_padding_v.label: Vertical content padding
content_padding_v.description: Extra padding inside Noctalia's built-in panel padding. Large values can leave too little room for two lines.

max_text_width.label: Maximum text width (0 = off)
max_text_width.description: Optional maximum width of each label before it is ellipsized. Set to 0 to show text without an explicit width limit.

summary_font_size.label: Summary font size
summary_font_size.description: Font size for the first line.

summary_color.label: Summary color
summary_color.description: Theme role or fixed color for the first line.

body_font_size.label: Body font size
body_font_size.description: Font size for the optional second line.

body_color.label: Body color
body_color.description: Theme role or fixed color for the optional second line.

text_align.label: Text alignment
text_align.description: Alignment of summary and body within the wider label.

two_line_balance.label: Two-line optical balance
two_line_balance.description: Invisible trailing space that shifts a two-line block upward by half this amount for pixel-level optical centering.

info_icon.label: Info glyph
info_icon.description: Glyph used by info and unknown severities.

info_icon_color.label: Info glyph color
info_icon_color.description: Theme role or fixed color for info glyphs.

warn_icon_color.label: Warning glyph color
warn_icon_color.description: Theme role or fixed color for warning glyphs.

error_icon_color.label: Error glyph color
error_icon_color.description: Theme role or fixed color for error glyphs.

content_fill.label: Inner content fill
content_fill.description: Fill behind the host-inset content box; transparent by default. This cannot recolor Noctalia's outer panel card.

content_border.label: Inner content border color
content_border.description: Border color for the host-inset content box.

content_border_width.label: Inner content border width
content_border_width.description: Border width for the host-inset content box; zero disables it.

content_radius.label: Inner content corner radius
content_radius.description: Corner radius for the host-inset content box.

profile_rules.label: Profile rules (JSON)
profile_rules.description: Ordered mako-style match rules; later matches win. See the installed README for schema and examples.
